title: Document consolidated rollback procedure and time estimate
procedure: Freeze the serialized queue and identify the current consumer transaction.
Quiesce/restart the target through its owner-approved deployment path.
Clear/bypass installer cache; select retained pre-change coordinate and closure.
Restore exact bytes and verify package metadata, imported module origins, CLI/version, and installed-file inventory.
Run the recorded consumer contract, startup/health/business smoke, monitoring, and redaction probes.
Compare against the pre-change baseline and verify no source, credential, database, configuration, or live TDT_HOME mutation.
Mark rolled_back only after all checks pass; otherwise mark rollback_failed and escalate.
If the target must remain on candidate, reinstall the same candidate bytes and rerun candidate health/observation gates.

time_estimate.per_consumer: 15-30 minutes for a non-deployable/CI or simple disposable target; 30-60 minutes for a service requiring quiesce/restart and observation.
time_estimate.ecosystem: Serial sum of per-consumer target windows plus owner approvals; no fixed total is claimed without target-specific windows.
time_estimate.basis: Estimate includes artifact restore, identity verification, consumer probes, and evidence capture; it excludes incident remediation.

rollback_trigger_examples: rollback artifact unavailable or hash mismatch
finding: Consolidated procedure and bounded estimate are documented. It has not been exercised because no consumer was promoted.
